summary: Restoration Medicine has a rare reputation: 162 five-star reviews from clients who say you never push products, and some travel three hours to see you. But Paddington and Woollahra are full of five-star skin clinics, and new clients can't see what makes you different before they choose.

you.notes: Nurse-led; late opening Tue and Thu only

visibility: In our search for your name, your own site did not appear; results mixed in Paddington, London clinics and a Time Out article about a nearby competitor. When five-star clinics surround you, being found by name matters.
lead: Clients say you never push products: rare and very valuable in this industry.
Clients travel hours to see you; brides-to-be trust you with their skin.
Saturday hours to 3pm, longer than several nearby clinics.
lose: With five-star clinics on every street, new clients can't tell you apart from a Google listing alone.
A nearby clinic stays open until 8pm on Mondays.
Your loyal clients' stories (calm skin before a wedding, long-term anti-ageing) aren't visible to newcomers.

gaps.title: Your name shows a competitor's feature
gaps.detail: When we searched for Restoration Medicine, a Time Out feature about a nearby skin clinic appeared, along with clinics in Paddington, London, but not your website.

gaps.title: Your difference is invisible to new clients
gaps.detail: 'Never pushes products' is your strongest story, but it only lives in reviews. New clients choosing between five-star clinics never see it.

gaps.title: Long-term plans rely on memory
gaps.detail: Skin plans and anti-ageing treatments work over months. Without automatic reminders and check-ins, clients lose momentum.

actions.title: Tell your 'no pressure' story on your own page
actions.why: Put your honest, nurse-led approach front and centre, so new clients choose you over other five-star clinics.

actions.title: Automate treatment plan reminders
actions.why: Clients stay on track, and you stay their clinic for the long term.

actions.title: Launch a bridal skin package
actions.why: Doable today: a simple 3-month pre-wedding plan you can promote on Instagram.

plan.detail: Automatic messages that keep every client's skin plan on track.

plan.title: Bridal and seasonal promotions
plan.detail: Targeted offers sent to the right clients at the right time.

search.result: Your own website did not appear. Results mixed in skin clinics in Paddington, London (Treatwell, Doctify UK), a Birdeye review page for you, and a Time Out feature on a nearby competitor, Lisa Rush Skin Clinic.
search.meaning: Searching your name shows clinics on the other side of the world and a magazine feature about a competitor.

headline.title: We searched for Restoration Medicine. Your website appeared in none of the 18 results.
headline.detail: Instead: skin clinics in Paddington, London, and a Time Out feature about a skin clinic around the corner from you.

scenario: A bride-to-be hears that 'Aisling at Restoration Medicine fixed my skin before my wedding'. She searches it and finds clinics in London and a Time Out article about another Paddington skin clinic. That clinic is open late on Mondays and has a feature in a magazine. She books a consultation there.
nochange: Your honest, no-pressure approach stays a secret kept in reviews, and five-star competitors with stronger online presence keep winning the clients who would have travelled hours to see you.
